sloka: बहुशो हि मया दृष्टः सागरे स महाबलः ।भुजगान् उद्धरन् पक्षी महावेगो महायशाः ॥४-६६-५॥
transliteration: bahuśo hi mayā dṛṣṭaḥ sāgare sa mahābalaḥ ।bhujagān uddharan pakṣī mahāvego mahāyaśāḥ ॥4-66-5॥

translations.english: 'Garuda is very powerful, swift, and famous. I have seen him snatching serpents from the ocean many times.
